questions.question: Bangladesh does not share its boundary with which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

Bangladesh shares its borders with the Indian states of **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bangladesh is a country in South Asia that shares its border with India to the north, east, and west, Myanmar to the east, and the Bay of Bengal to the south.
 
• Tripura, Assam, West Bengal, Meghalaya, and Mizoram are the Indian state that shares their border with Bangladesh. 
 
• **Dhaka, Rangpur, Khulna, Sylhet, Rajshahi, and Chittagong are the division of Bangladesh that are situated along the India Bangladesh Border.**
 
• Nagaland does not share a border with Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It launched a 10-day “golden jubilee” on March 17 with parades, fireworks, and tributes to independence hero Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

questions.question: According to Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), BPL (Below Poverty Line) person aged 60 years or above are entitled to a monthly pension of _______ up to 79 years of age as of October 2022.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 200.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **I**ndira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)

 
 
• The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme is a non-contributory old-age pension scheme
 
• It covers Indians who are 60 years and above and live below the poverty line.
 
• All IGNOAPS beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of **Rs. 200**
 
• Those** 80 years and above** receive a monthly pension amount of** Rs.500.​**
 
 

Features of Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme:

 
• Under IGNOAP scheme, senior citizens of India will receive monthly pension.
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme is a **non-contribution pension.
 
• It means that the beneficiary does not have to contribute any amount to receive the pension.

Eligibility Criteria:

 
• ** The age of the applicant** should be 60 years or higher. (It is applicable for both male & female).
 
• Applicant must belong to household living below poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Government.
 
• **Applicant must be destitute and having** no regular source of financial support form family members or any other sources is eligible for old age pension.
 
• BPL widows and BPL persons with severe and multiple disabilities in the age group of 60 -79 years are not eligible for this scheme.

questions.question: Which among the following is not a part of Western Ghats?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahadeo Hills.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mahadeo Hills are a range of hills in Madhya Pradesh state of central India.
 
• These are located in the northern part of the Satpura Range.
 
• Highest peak is Dhoopgarh.
 
• Satpura Mountain Range is southward of Vindhya Hills and parallel to it.
 
• Mahadeo Hills are located in Gujarat.
 
• Satpura range is a range of hills in Central India.
 
• The range rises in eastern Gujarat, through the border of Maharashtra and Madya Pradesh to the east of Chhattisgarh.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__The Western Ghats:__

 
• Also called the *Sahyadri*, the Western Ghats are a north-south chain of mountains that mark the western edge of the Deccan plateau region.
 
• **They rise abruptly from the coastal plain of the Arabian Sea as an escarpment of variable height, but their eastern slopes are much more gentle.**
 
• The horizontally bedded lavas due to weathering have given a characteristic ‘landing stair aspect’ to the relief of this mountain chain.
 
• Contain a series of residual plateaus and peaks separated by saddles and passes.
 
• Mahabaleshwar, located on a laterite plateau, is one of the highest elevations in the northern half, rising to 1,430 m.
 
• The chain attains greater heights in the south, where the mountains terminate in several uplifted blocks bordered by steep slopes on all sides, Those include the:
 
• Nilgiri Hills, with their highest peak, Doda Betta (2,637 m).
 
• the Anaimalai, Palni, and Cardamom hills**, all three of which radiate from the highest peak in the Western Ghats, Anai Peak (Anai Mudi (2,695 metres)).**

questions.question: Which British officer gave the order to open fire and led to the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Reginald Dyer__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Jallianwalla bagh incident is also known as the Massacre of Amritsar.**
 
• The incident took place on April 13, 1919, on Baisakhi day.
 
• There was dissatisfaction against Rowalatt Act that led to mass agitation. 
 
• The government was determined to suppress the mass.
 
• A large crowd was gathered in the Amristar on 13 April 1919 at Amristar in Jallianwalla Bagh, to protest against the arrest of their popular leaders Dr. Saif-ud-din Kichlu and Dr.Satyapal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• On the afternoon of **April 13**, a crowd of at least 10,000 men, women, and children gathered in the Jallianwala Bagh, which was nearly completely enclosed by walls and had only one exit.
 
• Brig. Gen. Reginald Edward Harry Dyer the military command of Amritsar wants to terrorize the people of Amritsar into complete submission. 
 
• **Dyer and his soldiers arrived and sealed off the exit**. Without warning, the troops opened fire on the crowd, reportedly shooting hundreds of rounds until they ran out of ammunition.
 
• **According to one official report, an estimated** 379 people were killed, and about 1,200 more were wounded.
 
• The government of India ordered an investigation of the incident (the Hunter Commission), which in 1920 censured Dyer for his actions and ordered him to resign from the military.
 
• 
 
Due to this incident, Rabindranath Tagore gave up his knighthood and Gandhiji relinquished his title ‘Kaiser-e-hind’ bestowed on him by the British for his services during the Boer War in South Africa.

questions.question: An image which cannot be obtained on a screen is called a _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __virtual image__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **An image that** cannot **be** obtained on a screen **is called a** virtual image.
 
• Images are of two types: real images **and** virtual images.
 
• Real images are formed on a screen, whereas virtual images cannot be obtained on the screen. 

Difference between real image and virtual image:

 
 

 Real Image__
 __Virtual Image__
 
 

 Real images are inverted
 Virtual images are erect
 
 

 Real images are formed on the screen
 Virtual images appear to be on the lens or the mirror itself
 
 

 Real images are formed by a concave mirror
 Plane, convex mirror, and concave lens form a virtual image
 
 

 Convex lenses form a real image
 Concave lenses form a virtual image
 
 

 Real images are formed due to the actual intersection of light rays
 Virtual images are formed due to the imaginary intersection of light rays

questions.question: The stage of the embryo in which all the body parts can be identified is called _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Foetus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The foetus** stage of the embryo is usually reached by the** end of the 8th week of pregnancy**.
 
• At this stage, all the major organs and body parts have developed and can be identified through **ultrasound**.
 
• The foetus is about 3 inches long and weighs around 1 ounce at this stage.
 
• The foetus continues to grow and develop until birth.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Uterus: It is the organ in which the embryo implants and develops during pregnancy.

 
• Ovulation: It is the process in which a mature egg is released from the ovary and travels down the fallopian tube, where it may be fertilized by sperm.
 
• Zygote: It is the fertilized egg that results from the fusion of a sperm and an egg. The zygote undergoes multiple cell divisions to form an embryo.

questions.question: The capital of Sangam kingdom ‘Pandyas’ was _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madurai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pandya dynasty **was one of the** three ancient Tamil dynasties (along with the Chola and the Chera) **that ruled parts of South India and Sri Lanka from around **300 BCE to 1650 CE**.
 
• The Pandya kingdom was located in the southern part of Tamil Nadu and had its capital in** Madurai**, which was also known as "Koodal Maanagar" or "the city of temples".
 
• Madurai was an important center of Tamil culture and literature during the Sangam period (300 BCE - 300 CE), which was characterized by the flourishing of Tamil poetry, music, drama, and art.
 
• The Pandya kings were known for their patronage of the arts, religion, and trade, and they played a significant role in the political, social, and economic history of South India.
 
• The other options mentioned in the question are also important places in Tamil Nadu with historical and cultural significance. Thiruvarur is known for its temple dedicated to Lord Tyagaraja, Kaveripattanam is an ancient port town on the east coast of Tamil Nadu, and Nagapattinam is a coastal town that was an important center of trade and culture during the medieval period. However, none of these places was the capital of the Pandya kingdom during the Sangam period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the largest cities in Tamil Nadu is Madurai. It serves as both the administrative center of the Madurai District and the cultural hub of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was the 33rd most populous city in India and the third largest urban agglomeration in Tamil Nadu, behind Chennai and Coimbatore, according to the 2011 census.
 
• With a recorded history spanning over 2500 years, Madurai, situated on the banks of the River Vaigai, has been a significant settlement for two millennia.

questions.question: For a person to be eligible to become the Vice-President of India, he must be of _____ years of age.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**35**__.

__
 
• **The Constitution of India **lays down the eligibility criteria for the** Vice-President of India,** and one of the requirements is that the person must be **at least 35 years of age.**
 
• The Vice-President of India is the second-highest constitutional office in the country, and the person holding this position acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, the Upper House of the Indian Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As the president of the Republic of India's deputy, the vice president is known as the vice president of India. As the vice president, you hold the second-highest constitutional post after the president. 
 
• The vice president at the moment is Bharatiya Janata Party member Jagdeep Dhankhar.
 
• After defeating Margaret Alva, a candidate from the Indian National Congress, in the 2022 Indian vice presidential election, he was elected vice president.
 
• The process for choosing the vice president is outlined in Article 66 of the Indian Constitution. Via the proportional representation system with single transferable votes and secret ballot voting overseen by the Election Commission of India, members of an electoral college made up of members of both Houses of Parliament and not state legislative assembly members indirectly elect the vice president.

questions.question: In India, roads are classified in the _____ classes according to their capacity.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The classification of roads in India** is based on the capacity of the road. This means that the number of lanes, width, and design of the road are all taken into account to determine its capacity.
 
• There are **six classes of roads in India**, with Class 1 being the highest capacity and Class 6 being the lowest. Class 1 roads are typically expressways or highways, while Class 6 roads are rural roads or village roads.
 
• The classification of roads is important for planning and development purposes. It helps policymakers to determine where to invest in infrastructure and which roads are in most need of improvement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In India, the classification of roads is based on the recommendations of the Indian Roads Congress (IRC). The IRC is a professional organization that provides guidance and standards for road development in India.
 
• Class 1 roads are typically expressways or highways that connect major cities and are designed for high-speed traffic. Class 2 roads are also highways but are designed for slightly lower speeds and connect smaller towns and cities.
 
• Class 3 roads are major district roads that connect smaller towns and villages. Class 4 roads are other district roads that connect rural areas. Class 5 roads are village roads that connect individual villages. Class 6 roads are rural roads that provide access to individual homes and farms.

questions.question: Jhijhiya is a famous folk dance of Bihar and is performed in the mythological town of Mithila. This dance is performed by women only. The whole Navaratri 'nine nights' festival is celebrated to worship the three forms of Lord ______.
questions.solution:

• **Jhijhiya** is a popular folk dance of Bihar, India, that is performed exclusively by women.
 
• The dance is performed during the Navaratri festival, which lasts for nine nights and is dedicated to the worship of the three forms of the Hindu goddess Durga: **Kali, Lakshmi, and Saraswati.**
 
• The festival is celebrated in the mythological town of Mithila, which is located in the northern part of Bihar.
 
• Jhijhiya is a fast-paced dance that is accompanied by traditional musical instruments such as the dhol, shehnai, and bansuri.
 
• The dance is typically performed by groups of women who wear colorful sarees and bangles, and the movements involve a lot of footwork and hand gestures.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 
 
**Additional Information__**

 
 
• Kali is one of the three forms of Durga, but the festival is dedicated to the worship of all three forms, not just Kali.
 
• Sita is not one of the three forms of Durga, and therefore, this option is incorrect.
 
• Parvati is one of the forms of the Hindu goddess Durga, but the festival is dedicated to the worship of Kali, Lakshmi, and Saraswati, not Sita, Kali, and Parvati.

questions.question: Which of the following god/goddess is NOT associated with Ratha Yatra festival of Puri, Odisha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Shiva**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratha Yatra** is a major festival celebrated in **Puri, Odisha, dedicated to Lord Jagannath, **his brother Lord Balabhadra, and their sister Devi Subhadra.
 
• **Lord Jagannath **is considered the main deity of the Ratha Yatra festival, and the festival is also known as the "Festival of Chariots" as the deities are taken out in grand chariots for a procession.
 
• Lord Balabhadra is the elder brother of Lord Jagannath and is also worshipped in Puri. Devi Subhadra is the younger sister of Lord Jagannath and is also worshipped during the Ratha Yatra festival.
 
• Lord Shiva is not associated with the Ratha Yatra festival of Puri, Odisha, although he is worshipped in other parts of India and is considered one of the major Hindu deities.

questions.question: Which of the following layers is NOT one of the atmospheric layers of the earth?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Endosphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Endosphere:** It is not a layer of the earth's atmosphere. The term "endosphere" is not commonly used in atmospheric science and may refer to the innermost layer of a planet or a star.
 
• Stratosphere: It is the second layer of the earth's atmosphere and is located between the troposphere and the mesosphere. The ozone layer is present in this layer, which helps in absorbing harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
 
• Thermosphere: It is the fourth layer of the Earth's atmosphere and is located above the mesosphere. The temperature in this layer can reach up to 2000 due to the absorption of high-energy solar radiation.
 
• Mesosphere: It is the third layer of the earth's atmosphere and is located above the stratosphere. Meteors burn up in this layer due to the high temperature caused by the friction of the meteor with the air molecules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are layers in Earth's atmosphere, and each layer has unique characteristics.
 
• Based on temperature, the Earth's atmosphere is subdivided into four layers: the troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, and thermosphere. Lower in the atmosphere are weather processes, and higher up are fascinating phenomena like the stunning aurora.
 
• We can gain insight into the functioning of the atmosphere by analyzing the temperature variations of the atmosphere with height.
